title: Grilled Australian Hash with Knobby Potatoes and Tofu
description: A flavorful and filling breakfast dish featuring the crunch of knobby potatoes and the richness of grilled tofu, all atop a bed of crispy Australian hash.
instructions: Cut the potatoes into 1-inch cubes and toss with 1 tablespoon of olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Grill the potatoes for 5-7 minutes per side, or until tender and golden brown.
Meanwhile, press and drain the tofu and cut it into 1-inch cubes.
Grill the tofu for 3-5 minutes per side, or until golden brown and crispy.
Cook the Australian hash according to package instructions.
To assemble, place a scoop of hash on a plate, top with grilled potatoes and tofu, and serve hot.
Garnish with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
